articles.summary: Everus Construction Group (NYSE: ECG) announced today that its Board of Directors has authorized a new $100 million share repurchase program, providing the company with additional flexibility to execute its returns-based capital allocation strategy. “Our new share repurchase authorization reflects our strong financial position, confidence in our business outlook and our commitment to the efficient allocation of capital,” said Jeffrey S. Thiede, president and CEO of Everus. “We continue to believe our strongest opportunities to create long-term value are through organic investments in our business and disciplined strategic acquisitions that diversify our business, expand our geographic reach and deepen our market presence. At the same time, we believe a balanced approach to capital allocation is important, and this authorization provides us with flexibility to repurchase shares when we believe doing so represents an attractive use of capital. articles.title: Everus Announces Authorization of New $100 Million Share Repurchase Program

articles.summary: Everus Construction Group (NYSE: ECG) today reported financial results for third quarter 2026. Third Quarter 2026 Summary (All comparisons versus the prior-year period unless otherwise noted, and results denoted with * are quarterly records.) Revenues of $1.38 billion*, up 40.3%. Net income of $91.9 million*, up 61.2%; net income margin of 6.6%. Diluted earnings per share (EPS) of $1.79*, up 61.3%. Earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization (EBITDA) of $140.2 million*, up 57.5%; EBITDA margin of 10.1%. Backlog of $5.48 billion*, up 69.8% from Dec. 31, 2025, and up 86.1% from Sept. 30, 2025. Net leverage of 0.7x. On Sept. 1, 2026, Everus completed the acquisition of Epsilon Industries. See the Non-GAAP Measures sections for definitions and reconciliations of the non-GAAP financial measures used in this news release.
